user.title: Set up Danske Fragtmænd
user.description: Danske Fragtmænd tracking needs no account — the hub is created right away. Add consignments afterwards via the integration options or the `danske_fragtmaend.track_parcel` service.

abort.already_configured: Danske Fragtmænd is already set up.

data_description.add: Paste the Danske Fragtmænd tracking link, or enter the consignment number. You find both in the carrier's text message or e-mail.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

parcels.title: Manage parcels
parcels.description: One consignment per line. Paste the tracking link from the Danske Fragtmænd text message or e-mail, or enter the consignment number, optionally followed by `/` and the key from that link. With the key you get the full record; the number alone gives a shorter one. The key is case-sensitive.

data_description.tracking_codes: A tracking link from the carrier's website, NUMBER/KEY, or a consignment number.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Danske Fragtmænd consignment number.
error.unsupported_link: Only the tracking link that opens with #/trackTrace/ is supported. Paste that link, or enter the consignment number.
error.not_recognised: Danske Fragtmænd does not recognise that consignment number or key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Danske Fragtmænd. Try again later.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a consignment by its Danske Fragtmænd tracking link or consignment number.

tracking_code.name: Tracking link or number
tracking_code.description: The tracking link from the carrier's message, or the consignment number.

key.name: Key
key.description: Optional: the key from the tracking link (case-sensitive). Not needed when you paste the whole link. Home Assistant records the data of every service call, key included; add the consignment through the integration options if you don't want that.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a consignment by its Danske Fragtmænd tracking link or consignment number.

tracking_code.name: Tracking link or number
tracking_code.description: The tracking link or consignment number to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
